rounds.text: G K Consultants Ltd is currently undergoing a significant fundamental turnaround, evidenced by a dramatic acceleration in sales growth from a long-term decline to a 115% increase over the trailing twelve months [E14, E15, E17]. This recent performance is not merely an outlier but part of a positive three-year trend of 26% compounded sales growth, which now comfortably outpaces the sector median of 16.4% [E16, E68]. The market has failed to price in this momentum, as the stock trades at a significant discount to its own book value with a P/B ratio of 0.83x [E2]. This valuation is particularly compelling when compared to the broader sector benchmark P/B of 1.36x, suggesting the company is undervalued relative to its asset base [E7]. Furthermore, the scanX signal engine confirms that profit growth is currently outpacing price growth by 270%, indicating that the company is beginning to outperform market expectations [E50]. Conceded: the high P/E ratio of 134x, the lack of dividend yield, and the decelerating earnings growth signal potential risks [E1, E4, E6, E61].
